analysis.executiveSummary: This proposal creates an exceptional strategic match between Northside Kings and Ravens Regime. By packaging Mike Evans and Kenny Gainwell for Tennessee's complete running back committee—Tony Pollard, Tyjae Spears, and rookie Nicholas Singleton—plus a 2027 4th pick, Northside Kings acquires total backfield stability (+18.3 C-AVI net gain) and long-term youth (+47.6 D-AVI net gain). Meanwhile, championship-contender Ravens Regime secures an elite WR starter in Mike Evans (82.7 C-AVI) to maximize their 2026 title window.
